s.t:
Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. More than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, rely on Airtable to transform how work gets done.

Airtable has a design system with real foundations and a community of designers and engineers who contribute to it. We’re looking for someone who can be dedicated to building out and evolving this system, as well as bring a sharp point of view on how AI changes the way UI gets built. You’ll sit in Design, but your work lives equally in Figma and production code. This is a high-autonomy IC role with broad cross-functional reach.

· Collaborate on the existing system. Assess its state, establish direction with other contributors, and close the gap between design specs and implementation.

· Build and ship components and tokens yourself, while evolving contribution standards with the broader community of designers and engineers who maintain the system alongside you.

· Develop and evangelize a point of view on AI-assisted UI development. Experiment with tooling, workflows, and system structures that make AI a reliable collaborator for anyone writing UI code: engineers, designers, and PMs.

· Build and maintain the AI tooling layer for UI: Claude skills, Cursor rules, LLM-consumable documentation, or whatever meaningfully improves the quality and velocity of coding UI.

· Partner with designers, engineers, and accessibility to Improve the quality of user experience created by everyone working with the system—through advocacy, better documentation, clearer patterns, and tooling that makes the right thing the easy thing.

· Your design craft is strong. You produce work you’re proud of and can articulate why it’s good. You hold design systems to a high bar, both in their visual expression and their technical implementation.

· You’re energized by both sides of the role. You move between design and code without treating one as a means to the other. You have a portfolio that shows both polished design work in application and production-quality libraries.

· You are actively curious about AI-assisted development. You’ve already experimented with LLM-driven tooling, Claude skills, codegen, or similar workflows, and you have opinions about where it’s heading.

· You are able to prioritize a path forward. You have strong instincts on sequencing and know what to fix now, what to document and defer, and what to let go.

· You raise the bar around you. The best version of this role doesn’t just improve the system—it improves how everyone at Airtable builds UI. You’re motivated by that multiplier effect.

· 8+ years at the intersection of design and engineering, with experience inheriting and evolving systems.

· Deep fluency in design tokens, component architecture, theming, and accessibility standards (WCAG).

· Ability to influence through craft, clarity, and relationships.

At CannonDesign we believe in leveraging data-driven solutions throughout our projects to improve outcomes. Our integrated BIM environment enables this process. The digital technology manager is responsible for ensuring the digital health and delivery of the project or program.

While this role requires technology expertise, the driving need of this role is to provide a strategic understanding of how technology (both new and existing) can be best leveraged on large complex projects.

This involves being part of the project from the RFP phases (recognizing any digital requirements or opportunities to advance technology), to being part of the capture and contract phase (to recognize any onerous digital requirements or capitalize on technology capabilities) through the digital planning of the design, execution and delivery phase of the project or program.

· Partner with project leadership, clients, and consultants to define and lead project-specific digital strategies encompassing BIM, VDC, data management, and technology integration from pursuit through delivery.

· Lead the development and review of contractual and digital deliverables, including BIM Execution Plans; escalate contractual or scope conflicts to Design Technology and Legal teams as needed.

· Identify and own project digital requirements, including BIM strategies, data exchange protocols, advanced model delivery, and digitally enabled workflows.

· Establish and oversee model management frameworks for large or complex programs, including audits, performance metrics, optimization strategies, and consistency across multiple teams or packages.

· Lead and facilitate digital coordination and client and consultant meetings (e.g., BIM/GIS coordination, clash detection, digitally enabled design reviews).

· Oversee software lifecycle compatibility, file version management, and data exchange strategies to ensure interoperability and efficiency within project team and consultants.

· Lead onboarding for CannonDesign and consultant team members, ensuring consistent understanding of digital strategy, workflows, collaboration platforms, and firm standards.

· Partner with the Design Technology team to define and implement best practices, standard workflows, and scalable processes for large programs.

· Mentor project teams in the implementation of firm tools, workflows, and emerging digital practices.

· Identify gaps in firm tools, capabilities, or processes and propose enhancements or new technologies to improve project outcomes and advance firm expertise.

· Lead the evaluation, piloting, and integration of new digital tools and workflows on projects; collaborate with Design Technology to scale successful solutions across teams and offices.

· Manage member access, permissions, and project-specific licenses for digital environments; ensure compliance and coordinate with IT and Design Technology on access strategies

· Support digital collaboration across multi-office teams and external partners to maintain model health and delivery quality.

· Travel as required.

· Bachelor or Master degree in Architecture, Engineering, Design Technology, or related field required.

· Minimum of 7 years of experience working in the digital realm of the A/E/C industry with a solid understanding of project phases from design through construction/close out required.

· Prior experience in BIM management, VDC coordination etc. for large programs or projects is preferred.

· Good verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills,

· Must have experience training others in the design, delivery, and use of BIM.

· Strong leadership skills and client engagement capabilities.

· Must be knowledgeable in design software and comfortable with new technology testing and adoption.

· Strong technical knowledge of model authoring tools like Revit, analysis tools like, Insight 360, Dynamo, and review tools like Navisworks, Bluebeam, Revizto, Enscape and other Design Applications.

· Knowledge of the Revit API is preferred but not required.

At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. It’s more than a philosophy — it’s who we are, and it drives us to make a meaningful, lasting difference every day.

· We are relentless in our pursuit of client adoration (not simply satisfaction). Consistent delivery of the best service is what we are about.

We support equity, diversity, and inclusion efforts that benefit all employees through the leadership of our DEI Council, our Employee Resource Groups which are open to everyone, and other community initiatives.

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We’re looking for a talented Product Design Technologist to join our forward-thinking Industrial Design team in San Francisco. Please note: this is a fully on-site role dedicated specifically to serving the creative needs of the design studio, rather than traditional hardware engineering validation.

In this role, you’ll be the heartbeat of our physical design process—translating visionary concepts into reality through advanced fabrication, and influencing the studio through your deep technical mastery of making.

· Build diverse prototypes: Fabricate a wide array of physical models for the design team—ranging from quick, iterative volumetric shape studies to high-fidelity, presentation-ready aesthetic and functional prototypes.

· CAD & CAM programming: Partner closely with the team to take CAD models or rough concepts and seamlessly bridge the gap to perfectly executed physical objects. Utilize software (specifically Rhino, Siemens NX, and Fusion 360) to translate complex surfacing and design intent into models and toolpaths.

· Operate machinery and techniques: Expertly set up and run CNC machines, laser cutters, 3D printers, and manual machine tools. Execute a wide range of hands-on processes, including molding, casting, blasting, and polishing etc.

· Material exploration: Build models using a vast array of materials and help the design team explore new materials, finishes, textures, colors, and processes.

· Be an inspiration: Act as the studio’s subject matter expert in making. Inspire the team, share your knowledge of manufacturing processes, and foster a strong culture of world-class craftsmanship.

s.h: We would love to have you on our team if you have
s.t:
· 5+ yrs experience as a prototype engineer, model maker, or in a similar role.

· Strong experience in CAD and CAM programming, with deep, practical experience using softwares like Rhino, Siemens NX, and Fusion 360.

· Strong hands-on experience operating CNC machines, general machining equipment, laser cutters, and various 3D printing technologies.

· Deep expertise in building high-quality models from a wide variety of materials.

· An exceptional eye for details and quality.

· A comprehensive portfolio that showcases your mastery in model making, workflows, and craftsmanship.

· Strong communication and collaboration skills—able to thrive in a fast-paced environment and help the team solve complex physical challenges.

· A passion for making and the ability to work 100% on-site at our San Francisco location.

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. We’ve built a product that users love, and we plan to keep it that way by continuing to empathize with users and help them overcome their most significant challenges. Designing at Elation is humbling, challenging, and rewarding. Our users do work that affects human lives, and our tools can make or break that work.

As a Design Technologist , you'll own the design and engineering of Elation’s design system while defining how AI-native systems compose UI — directing the interaction patterns, visual language, and developer experience that make it all feel simple.
Primary care clinicians have repeatedly awarded Elation "Best in KLAS" in our category, a recognition that reflects our clinician-first approach to design. Reporting up through our Chief Product Officer, you'll work within our frontend platform team to collaborate with everyone from the designers and engineers within Elation to the physicians who rely on our product every day, delivering care to more than 25 million patients.
The right candidate thrives in complexity and brings the craft and curiosity this role requires. If you want to do complex, meaningful work at the place where design, engineering, and healthcare intersect, we'd love to hear from you!

Own the architecture, strategy, design, engineering, and evolution of Elation’s design system.
Lead an AI-agent-first rearchitecting of the design system. Encoding composition rules and component guidelines for an agent to discover and apply.
Help define Elation’s AI-native experience through component design, pattern development, and an opinionated point of view that moves how design and engineering build.
Help shape our application’s design direction and visual language.
Deeply understand and research our users — their problems, workflows, and jobs-to-be-done — to build the best-in-class tools for their work.
Support your partners in design and engineering to leverage these systems.

Success in this role can take many different shapes — we don’t expect you to arrive having mastered every part of it. If you feel you’re a strong candidate for this role and excited to collaborate, we encourage you to apply.
5+ years of experience creating and shipping complex, web-based products in a cross-functional team as a designer, engineer, or related role.
2+ years leading cross-functional projects or initiatives, with a proven record of driving strategy and execution.
A genuine multi-discipline practitioner. Strong at both design craft and building with modern frontend frameworks.
Strong knowledge of design systems.
Experience in health tech or other compliance-heavy industries.
AI-native work practices and experience building with agentic tools like Claude Code or Cursor.

Experience designing or building for AI-native user experiences.
Strong API literacy and data modeling experience.
Accessibility and WCAG experience.
Experience building AI platform or infrastructure (MCP servers, eval harnesses, token build pipelines).

Experience using AI-powered tools for design, prototyping, content creation, and workflow optimization.

Advance proficiency in Figma for UX design, wireframing, and prototyping.

Understands both the UX process and creative design process.
Is highly proficient in using AI to create high-fidelity prototypes and experience concepts.

Can leverage AI to conduct website assessments, usability reviews, and experience evaluations.
Enjoys experimenting with new tools and finding innovative ways to improve workflows.

AI-Powered Design & Prototyping
Create high-fidelity prototypes using AI-powered design and development tools.
Rapidly transform concepts into interactive experiences for stakeholder reviews, customer validation, and usability testing.

Support teams in moving from idea to testable prototype with greater speed and efficiency.

Partner with creative, content, marketing, and UX teams to develop assets that align with brand standards and project goals.
Experiment with emerging AI capabilities to enhance storytelling, concept communication, and design execution.
Maintain awareness of evolving AI tools and best practices within the creative industry.

Conduct website and digital experience assessments using AI-assisted tools and methodologies.
Analyze usability, accessibility, content effectiveness, visual consistency, and customer experience opportunities.
Generate insights, recommendations, and improvement strategies that help elevate digital experiences.
Support heuristic evaluations, competitive analyses, and customer experience reviews.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with UX, Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Marketing teams to support innovation initiatives.
Help establish AI-enabled workflows that improve efficiency across design and creative processes.
Share best practices, emerging trends, and AI capabilities with team members.
Contribute to a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and innovation.

As a Senior Prototyping Engineer – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration , you will become an integral part of our Prototyping team, supporting the development of our Reliant platform – a next-generation long-range eVTOL unmanned aerial system designed for demanding ISR and logistics missions. Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.
In this role, you will be responsible for the integration, development, and validation of thermal management and cooling systems for the aircraft.

You will develop efficient cooling concepts for hybrid propulsion components, power electronics, avionics, and other heat-generating systems by optimizing airflow, aerodynamic cooling, and thermal integration.

Working closely with mechanical, propulsion, and systems engineering teams, you will ensure reliable operation across demanding flight and environmental conditions.

s.h: What is your Day to Day Mission
s.t:
Lead the integration and development of thermal management and cooling systems for UAVs.
Design and optimize cooling concepts for combustion engines, generators, power electronics, avionics, and other onboard systems.
Develop aerodynamic cooling solutions, including airflow management, ducting, air inlets and outlets, heat exchangers, and passive and active cooling concepts.
Define thermal system architectures balancing cooling performance, weight, packaging, reliability, and manufacturability.
Design, build, and commission prototype cooling test rigs and instrumentation for system validation.
Plan and execute thermal, environmental, endurance, and performance test campaigns.
Analyze thermal performance, airflow distribution, and system efficiency, implementing improvements based on test results.
Collaborate closely with propulsion, mechanical, structures, and systems engineering teams to optimize thermal integration within the aircraft.
Support simulation activities and correlate analytical models with physical test results where appropriate.
Prepare technical documentation, verification reports, and engineering recommendations.

s.h: What you bring to the team
s.t:
Degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Aeronautical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience developing and integrating thermal management or cooling systems in aerospace, automotive, motorsport, industrial machinery, or similar industries.
Hands-on experience designing and integrating air-cooled systems, aerodynamic cooling solutions, or airflow management for engines, electronics, or other high-power systems.
Strong understanding of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, cooling system design, airflow management, and thermal testing .
Experience with cooling components such as heat exchangers, fans, ducting, air intakes, ventilation systems, and thermal insulation.
Experience designing and executing engineering validation and prototype test campaigns.
Familiarity with CAD tools ( CATIA preferred); experience with CFD or thermal simulation tools is advantageous but not essential.
Experience with thermal instrumentation, sensors, and data acquisition systems.
Programming experience with Python , MATLAB , or similar data analysis tools is an advantage.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Fluent in English; German is a plus.

As a Senior Prototyping Engineer – Hybrid Power & Fuel System Integration, you will become an integral part of our Prototyping team, supporting the development of our Reliant platform – a next-generation long-range eVTOL unmanned aerial system designed for demanding ISR and logistics missions. Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.
In this role, you will take ownership of the integration, development, and validation of the aircraft's hybrid power generation system, including the internal combustion engine, fuel storage and delivery system, generator, and associated electrical and control interfaces.

You will ensure reliable, safe, and efficient operation of the complete propulsion system throughout the prototype development cycle by working closely with mechanical, electrical, propulsion, avionics, and systems engineering teams.

s.h: What is your Day to Day Mission

Lead the integration of the hybrid propulsion system, including the combustion engine, fuel system, generator, and power electronics into prototype aircraft.
Develop and validate fuel storage, distribution, and delivery systems, including tanks, pumps, filters, valves, sensors, and plumbing.
Design, build, and commission test rigs and dedicated test stands.
Develop and execute functional, endurance, and performance test campaigns for fuel and hybrid power systems.
Set up, integrate, commission, and troubleshoot combustion engines, generators, fuel systems, and associated control systems.
Analyze system performance, efficiency, reliability, and failure modes, implementing design improvements based on test results.
Collaborate closely with propulsion, mechanical, electrical, controls, and systems engineering teams to optimize system integration and aircraft performance.
Prepare technical documentation, verification reports, test procedures, and engineering recommendations to support prototype development.

s.h: What you bring to the team
s.t:
Degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Aeronautical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience integrating and testing combustion engines, hybrid propulsion systems, gensets, fuel systems, or power generation systems.
Hands-on experience setting up, integrating, commissioning, and testing internal combustion engines and associated fuel systems.
Strong understanding of fuel systems, fluid dynamics, pressure systems, combustion engines, generators, electrical power systems, and hybrid propulsion architectures.
Experience designing, building, and operating engineering test setups, test stands, and validation rigs.
Experience with instrumentation, sensors, CAN communication, embedded systems, avionics integration, and data acquisition.
Programming experience using Python, MATLAB, C++, LabVIEW, or similar for test automation and data analysis is an advantage.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional collaboration skills with a hands-on approach to prototype development.
Fluent in English; German is a plus.
